ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the famous scenic spot Sheng'an Pavilion in the Western Hills of Kunming is founded on a regular hexagon with a radius of 3m. What is the perimeter of the regular hexagon in meters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect $OA$ and $OB$,\\
since the radius of the regular hexagon is $3m$,\\
therefore $OA=OB=3m$,\\
since the figure is a regular hexagon,\\
therefore $\angle AOB=60^\circ$,\\
therefore $\triangle AOB$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
therefore $AB=3m$,\\
therefore the perimeter of the regular hexagon is: $3\times 6=\boxed{18m}$.
